body.name: Same-panel block-moment vector and covariance estimate
body.construction: \(\widehat z\) stacks the \(L\) target-plus-donor block means, the donor-only post mean, and \(n^{-1}\sum_{\ell=1}^{L}\sum_{t\in\ell}(Y_t-\overline Y_\ell)(Y_t-\overline Y_\ell)^{\prime}\); \(\widehat V\) is the corresponding block/HAC covariance estimator formed from \(\widehat\phi_t\) with logarithmic bandwidth and explicit deletion of the finitely many block-boundary lag pairs.
